scope: Candidate A only: skip unused package map when no available module; local CPU inventory CLI, unchanged result semantics

implementation.procedure: Read baseline/candidate actual code and freeze SHA; inspect no global caching and identical version ordering
implementation.acceptance: Only skip unused map; declared versions and fresh standalone probes retained

reference_boundary.procedure: Run existing unit tests plus absent/command-only/declared metadata, successful inferred and failing mapping cases
reference_boundary.acceptance: All pass; no backend initialized; parsed full JSON matches baseline

data_integrity.procedure: Hash sources, wrapper, registry, raw outputs; five alternating paired samples after separate warmup pair
data_integrity.acceptance: No omitted failures; exact output equality each pair; both zero exit; samples complete

reproducibility.procedure: Independent reviewer runs frozen script/tests and checks exact input/version/raw identities

numerical_sanity.procedure: Use five paired wall measurements, report each and medians/min/max; profiler separate; verify finite positive seconds, units and recompute all ratios from raw samples
numerical_sanity.acceptance: Median wall reduction >=10%, every pair reduction >=5%; otherwise inconclusive, do not claim benefit

measurement_validity.procedure: Same interpreter/env/cwd/registry/stdout capture; no package/backend install or concurrent benchmark
measurement_validity.acceptance: Scope only real local missing-backend inventory workload; no inference/model/other-platform generalization
